name: china-workday
title: 中国工作日查询 China Workday Checker
description: 中国工作日与法定节假日查询，专为职场场景设计。Use when the user asks whether a specific date is a workday or holiday in China, needs makeup-workday (补班) reminders, wants to count workdays in a month, or plans schedules around Chinese public holidays. Built-in data for 2025–2026 from official State Council notices. No API key, no network required.
